title: Create a branch
prompt:
• Create a branch based off of main called [Insert Branch].
• Make sure you've pulled the latest changes from main.

title: Checkout another branch
prompt:
• Run git fetch
• Check out this branch [Insert Branch]

title: Find a component
prompt: • Point me to this component in the repo [Insert Screenshot]

title: Polish a feature
prompt:
Examples:
• Update the padding from 4px to 8px for this component [Insert Screenshot]
• Update the typography from body-md to body-sm [Insert Screenshot]

title: Align design patterns
prompt:
• Apply the pattern from image 1 to image 2
• [Insert Screenshot 1] and [Insert Screenshot 2]
note: Agent will need sufficient context of designs in Screenshot 1

title: Generate a description
prompt:
• Create a PR description based on the changes in this branch
• Make sure you follow the template in the repo
• Let me review the description first. Do not push until I approve it.

title: Create a PR
prompt:
• Add and commit the changes
• Run /mms-create-pr
• Do not add PR to the review queue

title: Install MetaMask Skills
prompt: • Run yarn install and yarn skills

title: Create design specs from Slack messages
prompt:
• Read this conversation in this Slack thread [insert link]
• Using this skill [insert skill], draft a rough feature spec

title: Create a competitive brief
prompt:
• Use this skill [Insert Skill]
• Evaluate MetaMask's feature against Product 1, Product 2 and Product 3

title: Babysit a PR
prompt:
• Use /autopilot
• Babysit [Insert Link]
• Keep looping until mergeable + green CI + comments triaged

title: Test animations
prompt: • Apply these specs to this component [Insert Link]

title: Create a TestFlight build
prompt:
• Create a TestFlight build using [this workflow](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/actions/workflows/build-and-upload-to-testflight.yml)
• Use the default workflow from main and all other default presets
• Set Branch, tag, or SHA to build as [Insert Branch]

title: Generate a Figma component from code
prompt:
• Use [this skill](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-design-system/pull/1234) from the MetaMask Design System repo
• Create this component [Insert Link] in this Figma this page [Insert Link]
